description: This file contains the implementation of the ImmutableTarget class, which is an immutable representation of a Target in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, getters, and a builder for constructing instances.

classes.name: ImmutableTarget
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the Target interface, representing a connectivity target with properties like address, topics, QoS, authorization, acknowledgements, headers, and payload mappings.

classes.name: ImmutableTarget.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing ImmutableTarget instances with fluent API.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableTarget instance from a JSON object, parsing fields like topics, authorization context, acknowledgement label, header mapping, and payload mapping.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the ImmutableTarget instance into a JSON object, including all relevant fields.

methods.name: withAddress
methods.description: Returns a new Target instance with the specified address.
